_comment: drupilot KNOWN-GOOD dev-toolchain matrix (the distributed reference lock). Exact versions installed and verified TOGETHER end to end in a fresh DDEV Drupal 11 test-bed: install, the install-toolchain.sh smoke test (Rector dry-run with the Drupal 10 set + phpstan --version), run-rector.sh dry-run on a real contrib module, PHPStan and PHPCS. scripts/env/install-toolchain.sh pins these when a project has no complete lock yet (deterministic mode), so a fresh test-bed created after a broken upstream release still gets a working set. Only add a version here after verifying it the same way; never edit one in by hand. Packages missing from 'toolchain' are resolved from the config/defaults.json .packages ranges (drupal/core-dev is always matched to the installed core instead).
_remediation_comment: The packages printed in the 'by hand' fix command after a failed smoke test or a Rector crash: the ones whose combination breaks Rector.

known_broken.cause: drupal-rector's drupal-10.0-deprecations.php needs Rector\Symfony\Set\TwigSetList::TWIG_24, which the rector-symfony bundled in rector/rector 2.6.2 removed. Verified: 2.6.1 works, 2.6.2 and 2.6.7 crash.

known_broken.symptom: MissingPrivatePropertyException: Property "$container" was not found in "PHPStan\Parser\RichParser"
known_broken.cause: rector 2.5.x reads a private PHPStan property that later PHPStan 2.2.x releases removed; rector 2.5.2 needs phpstan 2.2.2.
